crossRefs.note: You will see the affliction of my habitation, in all the wealth which I will give Israel. There shall not be an old man…
and delivered his strength into captivity, his glory into the adversary’s hand.
This will be the sign to you that will come on your two sons, on Hophni and Phinehas: in one day they will both die.
Their priests fell by the sword, and their widows couldn’t weep.
Woe to the wicked! Disaster is upon them; for the deeds of his hands will be paid back to him.

people.name: Eli
people.line: High priest and judge of Israel at Shiloh

people.name: Hophni
people.line: A corrupt priest, son of Eli.

people.name: Phinehas
people.line: Wicked son of Eli the priest

translations.web: God’s ark was taken; and the two sons of Eli, Hophni and Phinehas, were slain.
translations.bsb: The ark of God was captured, and Eli’s two sons, Hophni and Phinehas, died.
